trajectory similarity is refused: 1 of 15 pairs is eligible and the mean correlation sits inside the closure null
levels are not identified: a company's posting count is a count of the boards that syndicate it
no table in this repository links a posting to a product decision; the construct is never measured
the collected schema holds postings, not the company; the construct has no column
the skill denominator is share_of_skilled; share_of_all confounds demand with description coverage
month-of-year seasonality needs more than one cycle and this collection has zero complete ones
posting_date is an aggregator first-seen date; the series describes discovery, which cannot carry an intent story
publishers are regional, so a country figure compares aggregator footprints, not hiring
